integrity: The proof is self-contained. Finite exhaustive and deterministic randomized checks are supplementary and are not used as an infinite proof. All literature comparisons are stated with their assumptions and do not treat unsuccessful search as proof of novelty.
limitations: The theorem classifies codimension-two targets reachable with exactly two occurrences of the rank-(n-1) letter. In the even antipodal case it does not determine reachability with three or more such occurrences. Originality remains subject to the possibility of an older equivalent formulation under transformation-semigroup terminology.
title: Two-defect reachability in cyclic defect-one automata
